title: Validation and Evaluation for Trustworthy (VET) Artificial Intelligence Act
last_action: Reported by the Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation with an amendment.
status: Reported by Senate committee; expired at the end of the 118th Congress
summary: Would have directed NIST to develop voluntary guidelines for internal and external assurance of artificial intelligence systems.
committee_dynamics: The committee-reported measure focused on assurance practices rather than mandatory developer duties and expired without final passage.
